preprocessing.note: Must be byte-identical to the training transform. Unverified until the golden-image parity test runs against real training code.

knownLimitations: RICE_NORMAL is 100% studio imagery; healthy-rice field performance is UNVALIDATED and must not be claimed (ADR-021 decision 2, option c).
Both chilli sources are studio imagery separable by capture style; the merged chilli label space is not trusted until the source-separability probe runs (ADR-021 decision 4).
Stock-image quarantine is filename-evidence only. Pixel-burned watermarks with neutral filenames are NOT caught and need the human review queue.
Rotated/mirrored publisher augmentations are undetectable by the duplicate method; augmented groups are excluded by construction, not by detection.

COTTON.note: 6 classes. Ships only once each has a KB entry (en+hi) and the agronomist items (a)-(c) are signed off.

CHILLI.note: Trainable, but no field-robustness claim: both sources are studio imagery and no field-realistic chilli evaluation set exists yet.

RICE.note: Healthy-rice field-condition performance is unvalidated. Do not claim field robustness for healthy-rice classification.

confoundEvaluationGates.evaluationGate: Metrics for CHILLI_ANTHRACNOSE, CHILLI_BACTERIAL_SPOT, CHILLI_NUTRIENT_DEFICIENCY and CHILLI_POWDERY_MILDEW MUST be reported with this confound stated, and MUST NOT be presented as evidence of disease-discrimination ability. The Grad-CAM background-reliance probe in docs/ml/error-analysis.md is REQUIRED for chilli before any chilli accuracy figure is published.
confoundEvaluationGates.residualRisk: Not removed, only contained. The only complete fix is chilli imagery of the same classes from a second capture style — no such data exists in the corpus.

confoundEvaluationGates.evaluationGate: The RICE_NORMAL <-> RICE_BROWN_SPOT confusion cell MUST be reported explicitly in the evaluation battery, not folded into macro-F1 alone. RICE_NORMAL recall MUST NOT be quoted as field performance. If RICE_NORMAL recall exceeds RICE_BROWN_SPOT recall by a wide margin, treat it as evidence of the shortcut, not of skill.
confoundEvaluationGates.residualRisk: Cannot be removed with the data on hand: no field-realistic healthy rice imagery exists in the corpus. The complete fix is field-realistic healthy rice data used FOR TRAINING, which ADR-021 decision 2 (option c) reserves for separate approval.

field.honestyNote: Field performance is far below in-domain performance. This number is published, not hidden (docs/ml/evaluation-plan.md).

calibrationNote: A threshold of 0.00 means the documented criterion is satisfied without excluding anything, so confidence-based abstention is inactive and the margin guard is the only mechanism producing an uncertain result. This is a product decision, not a measurement — see the reference points below.
